materials.name: Horsehair
materials.desc: Coarse, springy tail-hair sold by the hank. Bow-makers string fiddles with it and weavers use it to stiffen hats and brushes.

materials.name: Honey
materials.desc: Thick amber honey that never spoils. Healers dress wounds with it; brewers turn it into mead.

materials.name: Grain
materials.desc: A sack of barley or wheat. Food for people and horses, and the starting point for every still.

materials.name: Cooking Salt
materials.desc: Coarse grey sea salt. Keeps meat, seasons stew and scours pots.

materials.name: Clay (bulk)
materials.desc: Slick grey riverbank clay that holds a shape once fired. Used for moulds, jugs and crucibles.

materials.name: Fine White Sand
materials.desc: Pale, sifted sand, almost pure quartz. Glassmakers pay for it by the barrow.

materials.name: Limestone
materials.desc: Soft, chalky rock that crumbles white on the fingers. Burned for lime, carved for markers or cut into chalk sticks.

materials.name: Dressed Stone
materials.desc: A squared block of good building stone, chisel marks still sharp.

materials.name: Tin Ore
materials.desc: Dark, heavy pebbles of cassiterite. Worthless alone, priceless to a bronze-smith.

materials.name: Lead Ore
materials.desc: Dull blue-grey galena that leaves grey smears on the skin. Soft, heavy and faintly toxic.

materials.name: Hemp Fibre
materials.desc: Retted hemp stalks combed into long, tough, straw-coloured strands.

materials.name: Medicinal Herbs
materials.desc: A bundle of yarrow, comfrey and willow bark. Staunches bleeding, eases fever and fills every healer's satchel.

materials.name: Toxic Herbs
materials.desc: Dried nightshade, hemlock and foxglove, wrapped in waxed cloth. Handled with gloves by those who know better.

materials.name: Fragrant Flowers
materials.desc: Rose petals, lavender and orange blossom, dried or fresh. Perfumers steep them by the basketful.

materials.name: Fine Heartwood
materials.desc: A billet cut from the dense heart of an old yew, ash or rowan — tight-grained, flawless and springy. The only wood a wandwright will touch.

materials.name: Rock Crystal
materials.desc: A flawless lump of clear quartz, cold to the touch. Ground into lenses, cut into foci or polished into scrying spheres.

materials.name: Vinegar
materials.desc: Sharp, sour wine gone deliberately bad. Pickles food, cleans wounds and etches metal.

recipe.lore: A mash is left open to the air until it sours past ale and into vinegar.

materials.name: Madder Red Dye
materials.desc: Brick-red dye from madder root. Soldiers' coats and bridal veils alike.

materials.name: Woad Blue Dye
materials.desc: Foul-smelling vats of fermented woad that turn cloth a deep, lasting blue.

materials.name: Oak-Gall Black Dye
materials.desc: An iron-and-gall black that fades to a sober charcoal. Favoured by clerks, mourners and thieves.

materials.name: Weld Yellow Dye
materials.desc: A bright, sunny dye steeped from flowers.

materials.name: Forest Green Dye
materials.desc: A rich woodland green, the colour of hunters and druids.

recipe.lore: Cloth is dipped first in woad, then in weld.

materials.name: Shell Purple Dye
materials.desc: The royal purple, milked drop by drop from crushed sea snails. A bolt dyed with it is a statement of rank.

recipe.lore: Thousands of snails for a single vat — the stench of a dye-works carries for miles.

materials.name: Painter's Pigment
materials.desc: Ground ochre, malachite, soot and lapis bound in little pots of oil. For illumination, heraldry and portraiture.

materials.name: Tallow
materials.desc: Rendered animal fat, white and greasy. Cheap candles, soap, and grease for boots and axles.

materials.name: Bone Glue
materials.desc: Amber glue boiled from bones and hide scraps. Sets hard and holds a bow's laminations together.

recipe.lore: Bones are simmered for a day until the pot holds a thick, sticky jelly.

materials.name: Pine Pitch
materials.desc: Black, sticky resin cooked from pine. Waterproofs seams, seals barrels and makes torches burn.

recipe.lore: Resinous pine is baked in a covered pit until the pitch runs out.

materials.name: Wood Ash
materials.desc: Fine grey ash from a hardwood fire. Leached for lye or mixed into glaze.

materials.name: Lye
materials.desc: A caustic liquor leached from ash. Eats skin, cuts grease, and is the heart of soap and glass.

recipe.lore: Water is dripped slowly through a barrel of ash; the brown runoff is lye.

materials.name: Distilled Spirits
materials.desc: Clear, fiery liquor, strong enough to burn. Alchemists use it to draw out and carry volatile essences.

recipe.lore: A fermented mash is boiled through a copper still, keeping only the heart of the run.

materials.name: Oil of Vitriol
materials.desc: A heavy, oily acid that chars wood and bites through cloth. Stored only in glass or wax-sealed clay.

recipe.lore: Sulfur is burned with saltpeter over water; the fumes condense into acid.

materials.name: Glass Frit
materials.desc: Lumps of clear green-tinted glass, ready to be remelted and blown or ground.

materials.name: Hemp Cord
materials.desc: Tough, twisted cord. The basic stuff of rope, nets and sacks.

materials.name: Canvas
materials.desc: Heavy hemp canvas, oiled or waxed against the rain. Tents, sails and packs.

materials.name: Silk Thread
materials.desc: Lustrous, strong, almost weightless thread. Holds embroidery and enchantment alike.

components.label: Any silk (cocoons, spider silk or silk cloth)

recipe.lore: Silk from any source — silkworm, giant spider, or unpicked cloth — is reeled and twisted. Monster silk keeps its tags only if left unspun.

materials.name: Bowstring
materials.desc: A waxed, loop-ended string of twisted linen or sinew. Every archer carries a spare.

materials.name: Gut Strings
materials.desc: A coil of dried, twisted gut strings for lutes, viols and harps. Sings bright when new.

materials.name: Fletching Feathers
materials.desc: Trimmed, matched flight feathers ready to glue to arrow shafts.

materials.name: Leather Strips
materials.desc: Thongs and strapping cut from cured leather. For grips, lacing, buckles and bindings.

materials.name: Hardened Leather
materials.desc: Leather boiled in wax and moulded while hot; it dries stiff as horn. The stuff of breastplates for those who can't afford steel.

materials.name: Cured Fur
materials.desc: A tanned pelt with the fur still on, soft on one side and supple on the other. Warm, but any magic the beast had is gone.

recipe.lore: Like all tanning, curing a pelt strips its magic; use the raw pelt for enchanted work.

materials.name: Wooden Haft
materials.desc: A shaped, sanded ash or hickory handle, ready for an axe-head, spear-point or hammer.

materials.name: Bow Stave
materials.desc: A split and seasoned length of yew or elm, heartwood on the belly and sapwood on the back.

recipe.lore: Most of the time is simply drying; a green stave will crack at the first draw.

materials.name: Tin Ingot
materials.desc: A soft, silvery bar that crackles when bent.

materials.name: Lead Ingot
materials.desc: A dull, surprisingly heavy bar. Sling bullets, seals, pipe and solder.

materials.name: Bronze Ingot
materials.desc: Warm golden bronze that rings like a bell when struck. Cast into horns, bells, censers and holy symbols.

materials.name: Chain Links
materials.desc: A coil of small riveted iron rings, the building block of mail.

recipe.lore: Wire is drawn, wound round a mandrel, cut into rings and each one riveted shut.

materials.name: Steel Plates
materials.desc: Hammered and tempered steel plates, curved to fit a limb or torso.

materials.name: Copper Wire
materials.desc: A spool of fine drawn copper wire. Jewellers wrap settings with it; artificers swear it carries a spark.

materials.name: Silver Wire
materials.desc: Bright drawn silver wire for filigree, rings and circlets.

materials.name: Gold Wire
materials.desc: Soft, gleaming gold wire that bends without breaking — the finest jewellery starts here.

materials.name: Jeweller's Solder
materials.desc: Thin rods of low-melting tin-lead alloy for joining settings and clasps.

materials.name: Gold Leaf
materials.desc: Gold beaten so thin it trembles in a breath. Gilds holy icons, book spines and the letters of spell scrolls.

recipe.lore: An ingot is beaten between sheets of vellum for a day until it covers a table.

materials.name: Powdered Silver
materials.desc: Silver filed and ground to a glittering powder. Blessed into holy water, painted into wards, or fused onto blades to bite lycanthropes and fiends.

materials.name: Rag Paper
materials.desc: Thick, creamy sheets pressed from pulped linen rags. Cheaper than parchment, fine for playing cards and books.

materials.name: Potent Arcane Ink
materials.desc: Ink that shimmers like oil on water and refuses to dry until it is shaped into a sigil. Required to scribe spell scrolls of 2nd and 3rd level.

components.label: Any essence of uncommon or better

recipe.lore: A captured essence is bled into ink through a thread of quicksilver, which keeps the magic from boiling off.

materials.name: Greater Arcane Ink
materials.desc: Heavy, mercury-bright ink that hums faintly in its bottle. Required to scribe spell scrolls of 4th and 5th level.

components.label: Any essence of rare or better

recipe.lore: Powdered silver steadies the ink so a longer, stronger formula doesn't smear itself apart mid-casting.

materials.name: Sublime Arcane Ink
materials.desc: An ink that seems to have depth, like looking into a well at night. Required to scribe spell scrolls of 6th to 8th level.

components.label: Any essence of very rare or better

recipe.lore: Gold and diamond anchor a very-rare essence; without them the ink eats through the vellum.

materials.name: Primordial Arcane Ink
materials.desc: Ink that moves when unobserved and shows every colour at once. Only it can hold a 9th-level spell on a scroll.

recipe.lore: The distillation must run unbroken for fifteen days; a single lapse and the essence tears free.

items.name: Club
items.effect: Simple melee. 1d4 bludgeoning, light.

recipe.lore: A knotted branch, trimmed and weighted at the business end.

items.name: Dagger
items.effect: Simple melee. 1d4 piercing; finesse, light, thrown (20/60).

recipe.lore: One steel bar is drawn into three slim blades.

items.name: Greatclub
items.effect: Simple melee. 1d8 bludgeoning, two-handed.

items.name: Handaxe
items.effect: Simple melee. 1d6 slashing; light, thrown (20/60).

items.name: Javelin
items.effect: Simple melee. 1d6 piercing; thrown (30/120).

recipe.lore: A bundle of ash shafts tipped with iron from a single bar.

items.name: Light Hammer
items.effect: Simple melee. 1d4 bludgeoning; light, thrown (20/60).

items.name: Mace
items.effect: Simple melee. 1d6 bludgeoning.

items.name: Quarterstaff
items.effect: Simple melee. 1d6 bludgeoning, versatile (1d8). Doubles as a druidic or arcane focus if the wielder wishes.

recipe.lore: A straight sapling, peeled, fire-hardened and shod at both ends.

items.name: Sickle
items.effect: Simple melee. 1d4 slashing, light.

items.name: Spear
items.effect: Simple melee. 1d6 piercing; thrown (20/60), versatile (1d8).

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.effect: Simple ranged. 1d8 piercing; ammunition (80/320), loading, two-handed.

recipe.lore: A steel prod lashed to a carved stock, with a simple nut-and-trigger lock.

items.name: Dart
items.effect: Simple ranged. 1d4 piercing; finesse, thrown (20/60).

items.name: Shortbow
items.effect: Simple ranged. 1d6 piercing; ammunition (80/320), two-handed.

items.name: Sling
items.effect: Simple ranged. 1d4 bludgeoning; ammunition (30/120).

items.name: Battleaxe
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d8 slashing, versatile (1d10).

items.name: Flail
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d8 bludgeoning.

items.name: Glaive
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d10 slashing; heavy, reach, two-handed.

items.name: Greataxe
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d12 slashing; heavy, two-handed.

items.name: Greatsword
items.effect: Martial melee. 2d6 slashing; heavy, two-handed.

recipe.lore: The long blade must be quenched evenly along its whole length or it warps like a snake.

items.name: Halberd
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d10 slashing; heavy, reach, two-handed.

items.name: Lance
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d12 piercing; reach, disadvantage within 5 ft, two-handed unless mounted.

items.name: Longsword
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d8 slashing, versatile (1d10).

items.name: Maul
items.effect: Martial melee. 2d6 bludgeoning; heavy, two-handed.

items.name: Morningstar
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d8 piercing.

items.name: Pike
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d10 piercing; heavy, reach, two-handed.

items.name: Rapier
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d8 piercing, finesse.

recipe.lore: The swept guard is the hard part — a cage of bent iron bars riveted around the grip.

items.name: Scimitar
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d6 slashing; finesse, light.

items.name: Shortsword
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d6 piercing; finesse, light.

items.name: Trident
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d6 piercing; thrown (20/60), versatile (1d8).

items.name: War Pick
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d8 piercing.

items.name: Warhammer
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d8 bludgeoning, versatile (1d10).

items.name: Whip
items.effect: Martial melee. 1d4 slashing; finesse, reach.

recipe.lore: Thongs are plaited tightly over a short wooden core, tapering to a knotted cracker.

items.name: Blowgun
items.effect: Martial ranged. 1 piercing; ammunition (25/100), loading.

recipe.lore: A long cane or bored rod, its bore waxed smooth.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.effect: Martial ranged. 1d6 piercing; ammunition (30/120), light, loading.

recipe.lore: A tiny steel prod and a trigger lock no bigger than a thumbnail; one slipped file and the whole thing jams.

items.name: Heavy Crossbow
items.effect: Martial ranged. 1d10 piercing; ammunition (100/400), heavy, loading, two-handed.

items.name: Longbow
items.effect: Martial ranged. 1d8 piercing; ammunition (150/600), heavy, two-handed.

recipe.lore: A whole stave is tillered by hand, shaving a hair at a time until it bends in a perfect arc.

items.name: Net
items.effect: Martial ranged. Thrown (5/15); a Large or smaller target hit is restrained until it breaks or cuts free.

recipe.lore: Knotted hemp mesh with lead weights sewn into the rim.

items.name: Arrows (20)
items.effect: Twenty arrows for a shortbow or longbow.

recipe.lore: Shafts are split and planed, fletched with glued feathers, and tipped with heads forged from a single iron bar.

items.name: Crossbow Bolts (20)
items.effect: Twenty stubby bolts for any crossbow.

recipe.lore: Shafts are split and planed, fletched with glued feathers, and tipped with heads forged from a single iron bar.

items.name: Sling Bullets (20)
items.effect: Twenty cast lead bullets for a sling.

recipe.lore: Lead is poured into a clay mould, twenty bullets at a time.

items.name: Blowgun Needles (50)
items.effect: Fifty slim darts for a blowgun, each with a tuft of down to seal the bore.

items.name: Padded Armor
items.effect: Light armor. AC 11 + Dex; disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.effect: Light armor. AC 11 + Dex.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.effect: Light armor. AC 12 + Dex.

items.name: Hide Armor
items.effect: Medium armor. AC 12 + Dex (max 2).

recipe.lore: Thick hides and furs, layered and laced, barely tanned — crude but warm.

items.name: Chain Shirt
items.effect: Medium armor. AC 13 + Dex (max 2).

items.name: Scale Mail
items.effect: Medium armor. AC 14 + Dex (max 2); disadvantage on Stealth.

recipe.lore: Hundreds of overlapping metal scales are laced to a leather coat like the skin of a fish.

items.name: Breastplate
items.effect: Medium armor. AC 14 + Dex (max 2).

items.name: Half Plate
items.effect: Medium armor. AC 15 + Dex (max 2); disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Ring Mail
items.effect: Heavy armor. AC 14; disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Chain Mail
items.effect: Heavy armor. AC 16; Str 13 required; disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Splint Armor
items.effect: Heavy armor. AC 17; Str 15 required; disadvantage on Stealth.

items.name: Plate Armor
items.effect: Heavy armor. AC 18; Str 15 required; disadvantage on Stealth.

recipe.lore: Every plate is fitted to the wearer's own body; a suit made for someone else rubs and pinches.

items.name: Shield
items.effect: +2 AC while carried in one hand.

items.name: Cloak
items.effect: A hooded, knee-length traveller's cloak. The classic base for magical cloaks.

items.name: Robe
items.effect: A long, loose, belted robe of plain cloth, favoured by mages and monks.

items.name: Hat
items.effect: A broad-brimmed felt or straw hat.

items.name: Cap
items.effect: A close-fitting knitted or cloth cap.

items.name: Boots
items.effect: Sturdy calf-high leather boots with thick, double-stitched soles.

items.name: Sandals
items.effect: Simple strapped leather sandals.

items.name: Slippers
items.effect: Soft, silent cloth-and-leather slippers.

items.name: Gloves
items.effect: A pair of supple leather gloves.

items.name: Gauntlets
items.effect: Heavy leather gloves backed with riveted iron plates.

items.name: Belt
items.effect: A wide leather belt with an iron buckle.

items.name: Bracers
items.effect: A pair of stiff leather forearm guards.

items.name: Helm
items.effect: An open-faced iron helmet with a leather liner. (No AC bonus by itself.)

items.name: Common Clothes
items.effect: Plain shirt, trousers or skirt, and a smock.

items.name: Traveler's Clothes
items.effect: Hard-wearing clothes cut for the road, with deep pockets and a wool overshirt.

items.name: Fine Clothes
items.effect: Tailored, dyed, embroidered clothes suitable for court.

items.name: Costume
items.effect: A convincing outfit for playing a role — a guard, a priest, a noble.

items.name: Ring Band
items.effect: A plain, unadorned band of silver or gold — the blank from which every magic ring is made.

items.name: Amulet Setting
items.effect: An empty pendant mount on a fine chain, ready to cradle a gem or charm.

items.name: Periapt Blank
items.effect: A small hollow pendant with claws to hold a single stone against the wearer's chest.

items.name: Medallion
items.effect: A heavy bronze disc on a chain, its face left blank for engraving.

items.name: Necklace
items.effect: A fine silver chain with a sturdy clasp, suitable for stringing beads or charms.

items.name: Brooch
items.effect: A pin-backed cloak brooch of bronze or silver.

items.name: Circlet
items.effect: A slim silver headband, open at the brow for a stone.

items.name: Talisman Blank
items.effect: A thumb-sized carved token of wood, bone or stone on a leather thong.

items.name: Scarab Blank
items.effect: A beetle-shaped carved stone, flat underneath for an inscription.

items.name: Prayer Bead String (blank)
items.effect: A loop of wooden beads, counted through the fingers during meditation or prayer.

items.name: Sturdy Bag
items.effect: A heavy canvas sack with a drawstring; holds about a cubic foot.

items.name: Pouch
items.effect: A small leather belt pouch that closes with a thong.

items.name: Backpack
items.effect: A leather-framed pack with straps and side pockets.

items.name: Quiver
items.effect: A stiff leather case holding twenty arrows.

items.name: Component Pouch
items.effect: A watertight belt pouch divided into many small compartments for spell components; replaces material components with no listed cost.

items.name: Scroll Case
items.effect: A capped leather tube that keeps maps and scrolls dry.

items.name: Chest
items.effect: An iron-banded wooden chest with a hasp for a lock.

items.name: Wooden Box
items.effect: A small hinged box of fitted wood, about the size of a spellbook.

items.name: Glass Bottle
items.effect: A stoppered glass bottle holding about a pint and a half.

items.name: Flask
items.effect: A small clay or tin flask that holds a pint.

items.name: Jug
items.effect: A fired clay jug with a handle; holds a gallon.

items.name: Bowl
items.effect: A shallow bowl turned from a single block of wood.

items.name: Barrel
items.effect: An iron-hooped oak barrel holding 40 gallons.

items.name: Bucket
items.effect: A staved wooden bucket with a rope handle.

items.name: Waterskin
items.effect: A stitched leather bladder holding half a gallon.

items.name: Flask of Oil
items.effect: A pint of lamp oil. Can be thrown to douse a creature or poured to cover a small area; burns for 2 rounds if ignited (5 fire damage).

items.name: Candle
items.effect: Burns for an hour, shedding dim light in a small circle.

items.name: Torch
items.effect: Burns for an hour with bright light to 20 ft; can be swung as a club for 1 fire damage.

items.name: Hooded Lantern
items.effect: A tin lantern with glass panes and a shutter; bright light to 30 ft for 6 hours on a pint of oil.

items.name: Bullseye Lantern
items.effect: A lantern with a polished reflector that throws a 60-ft cone of bright light.

items.name: Lamp
items.effect: A clay oil lamp; bright light to 15 ft for 6 hours on a pint of oil.

items.name: Brazier
items.effect: A three-legged iron fire-bowl for coals, ritual fires or incense.

items.name: Censer
items.effect: A pierced bronze incense burner on a chain, swung in temple processions.

items.name: Wand Blank
items.effect: A flawless, hand-shaped length of fine heartwood — usable as an arcane focus, and the base for any magic wand.

recipe.lore: Only heartwood without a single knot or crack will carry a charge; most billets are rejected.

items.name: Rod Blank
items.effect: A heavy iron-capped rod about two feet long. Works as an arcane focus and as the base for magic rods.

items.name: Staff Focus
items.effect: A carved walking staff, balanced for a spellcaster's hand. Usable as a quarterstaff and as an arcane or druidic focus.

items.name: Orb
items.effect: A polished crystal or stone sphere about the size of a fist; an arcane focus.

items.name: Crystal Focus
items.effect: A clear, faceted shard of quartz, cut to catch light; an arcane focus.

items.name: Clear Crystal Sphere
items.effect: A flawless, perfectly round sphere of clear crystal on a small stand. Beautiful, and the only base a scrying ball can be made from.

recipe.lore: Days of grinding with ever-finer sand; a single hairline flaw and the sphere is useless for scrying.

items.name: Holy Symbol
items.effect: A deity's sign cast in bronze or silver and worn as an amulet or on a shield; a divine focus.

items.name: Druidic Totem
items.effect: A sprig of mistletoe bound to a carved yew twig with feathers and bone; a druidic focus.

items.name: Carved Figurine
items.effect: A palm-sized carved figure of an animal, in wood, bone or stone.

items.name: Small Cube
items.effect: A precisely squared wooden or stone cube, an inch or two on a side.

items.name: Polished River Stone
items.effect: A smooth, palm-sized river stone, tumbled until it gleams.

items.name: Spellbook
items.effect: A blank leather-bound book of 100 vellum pages, sturdy enough to hold a wizard's spells.

items.name: Blank Tome
items.effect: A heavy, blank bound book with brass corners, awaiting a scholar's hand.

items.name: Deck of Cards
items.effect: A hand-painted deck of playing cards on stiff paper.

items.name: Dice Set
items.effect: A set of bone or wooden dice with pips burnt in.

items.name: Carpet
items.effect: A knotted wool rug about six feet by nine, dyed in bold patterns.

items.name: Steel Mirror
items.effect: A small hand mirror of polished steel.

items.name: Folding Fan
items.effect: A painted paper fan on carved wooden ribs.

items.name: Broom
items.effect: A bundle of stiff straw bound to a wooden handle.

items.name: Smoking Pipe
items.effect: A carved briarwood pipe.

items.name: Lens Goggles
items.effect: Leather-strapped goggles with ground-glass lenses that keep grit and glare out of the eyes.

items.name: Ground Lens
items.effect: A carefully ground disc of clear glass that magnifies what lies beneath it.

items.name: Magnifying Glass
items.effect: A large ground lens in a bronze frame. Grants advantage on checks to appraise or inspect fine detail, and can start fires in sunlight.

items.name: Spyglass
items.effect: A brass-bound telescope; distant objects seem twice as close.

recipe.lore: Matching two lenses so their focus aligns takes months of patient grinding.

items.name: Hourglass
items.effect: Two glass bulbs and a pinch of sand that measure an hour.

items.name: Whetstone
items.effect: A flat, fine-grained stone for honing blades.

items.name: Hempen Rope (50 ft)
items.effect: Fifty feet of stout hemp rope; burst with a DC 17 Strength check.

items.name: Silk Rope (50 ft)
items.effect: Fifty feet of light, strong silk rope — half the weight of hemp.

items.name: Two-Person Tent
items.effect: A simple canvas shelter that sleeps two.

items.name: Bedroll
items.effect: A rolled wool blanket with a waxed canvas groundsheet.

items.name: Blanket
items.effect: A thick wool blanket.

items.name: Caltrops (bag of 20)
items.effect: Four-pointed iron spikes; scattered over a 5-ft square, they wound and slow anyone who walks through carelessly.

items.name: Ball Bearings (bag of 1,000)
items.effect: Tiny metal balls that can be spilled across a 10-ft square to trip anyone crossing it.

items.name: Crowbar
items.effect: An iron pry bar; grants advantage on Strength checks where leverage helps.

items.name: Grappling Hook
items.effect: A three-pronged iron hook with an eye for a rope.

items.name: Iron Spikes (10)
items.effect: Ten long iron spikes for wedging doors or anchoring ropes.

items.name: Pitons (10)
items.effect: Ten iron climbing pegs with rope eyes.

items.name: Chain (10 ft)
items.effect: Ten feet of heavy iron chain.

items.name: Manacles
items.effect: Iron shackles with a lock, sized for Small or Medium wrists.

items.name: Lock
items.effect: A sturdy iron padlock with a key.

items.name: Hunting Trap
items.effect: A toothed steel jaw trap on a chain; snaps shut on anything that steps in it.

items.name: Shovel
items.effect: An iron-bladed spade on a wooden handle.

items.name: Miner's Pick
items.effect: A heavy iron pick for breaking rock and ore.

items.name: Tinderbox
items.effect: Flint, steel and tinder in a small tin; lights a fire in about a minute.

items.name: Signal Whistle
items.effect: A shrill bone or tin whistle.

items.name: Signal Horn
items.effect: A curved horn that sounds a long, carrying note.

items.name: Bell
items.effect: A small bronze bell with an iron clapper.

items.name: Mess Kit
items.effect: A tin box that unfolds into a cup and plate.

items.name: Iron Pot
items.effect: A heavy cast-iron cooking pot holding a gallon.

items.name: Sealing Wax
items.effect: A stick of red wax for sealing letters.

items.name: Ink (1 ounce bottle)
items.effect: A small corked bottle of good black writing ink.

items.name: Ink Pen
items.effect: A trimmed quill with a split nib.

items.name: Rations (1 day)
items.effect: Hard biscuit, dried fruit, jerky and nuts — a day's food for one traveller.

items.name: Lute
items.effect: A round-backed, many-stringed instrument; a bard's classic companion and spellcasting focus.

items.name: Lyre
items.effect: A U-shaped hand harp strung across a wooden yoke.

items.name: Harp
items.effect: A triangular frame harp that sits on the knee.

items.name: Mandolin
items.effect: A small, bright-voiced lute with paired strings.

items.name: Cittern
items.effect: A flat-backed, wire-strung tavern instrument.

items.name: Viol
items.effect: A bowed string instrument played upright between the knees.

items.name: Dulcimer
items.effect: A trapezoid box strung with wires and struck with little hammers.

items.name: Flute
items.effect: A simple wooden transverse flute.

items.name: Pan Flute
items.effect: A row of reed or cane pipes lashed together, played by blowing across their tops.

items.name: Shawm
items.effect: A loud, double-reeded wooden pipe.

items.name: Drum
items.effect: A wooden drum with a stretched hide head.

items.name: Bagpipes
items.effect: A leather bag with chanter and drones; audible for miles.

items.name: Alchemist's Supplies
items.effect: Glass alembics, a mortar and pestle, a burner and many small jars. Proficiency covers identifying and brewing alchemical substances.

items.name: Brewer's Supplies
items.effect: A copper kettle, tubing, siphon and hops-sack for brewing ale and spirits.

items.name: Calligrapher's Supplies
items.effect: Quills, fine inks, a pen-knife and practice parchment for beautiful and precise lettering.

items.name: Carpenter's Tools
items.effect: Saw, hammer, nails, plane, square and chisels.

items.name: Cartographer's Tools
items.effect: Quills, ink, compass, calipers and a ruler for drawing maps.

items.name: Cobbler's Tools
items.effect: Awls, a last, a hammer and waxed thread for making and mending shoes.

items.name: Cook's Utensils
items.effect: A pot, knives, a ladle and a spoon.

items.name: Glassblower's Tools
items.effect: Blowpipe, marver, tongs and jacks for shaping molten glass.

items.name: Herbalism Kit
items.effect: Clippers, a mortar and pestle, pouches and vials. Required to craft antitoxin and potions of healing.

items.name: Jeweler's Tools
items.effect: Tiny saws, files, pliers, tweezers and a loupe for fine metalwork and gem-setting.

items.name: Leatherworker's Tools
items.effect: Knives, awls, a mallet, an edger and thread.

items.name: Mason's Tools
items.effect: A trowel, hammer, chisels, brushes and a square.

items.name: Painter's Supplies
items.effect: An easel, canvas, brushes, charcoal sticks and pots of paint.

items.name: Potter's Tools
items.effect: Wire cutters, ribs, scrapers, knives and calipers.

items.name: Smith's Tools
items.effect: Hammers, tongs, a small anvil, punches and files.

items.name: Tinker's Tools
items.effect: A kit of small hand tools, thread, needles, a whetstone, cloth and glue for mending and inventing.

items.name: Weaver's Tools
items.effect: Thread, needles and scraps of cloth for weaving and mending.

items.name: Woodcarver's Tools
items.effect: A knife, gouge and small saw.

items.name: Poisoner's Kit
items.effect: Vials, chemicals, gloves and a mortar for creating and applying poisons.

items.name: Thieves' Tools
items.effect: Picks, a tension wrench, a small mirror, narrow scissors and pliers. Proficiency lets you pick locks and disarm traps.

items.name: Disguise Kit
items.effect: Cosmetics, hair dye and small props to change your appearance.

items.name: Forgery Kit
items.effect: Papers, inks, seals, wax and gold and silver leaf for faking documents.

items.name: Navigator's Tools
items.effect: A sextant, compass, calipers, ruler and charts for plotting a course.

items.name: Healer's Kit
items.effect: A leather satchel of bandages, salves and splints. Ten uses; each stabilizes a dying creature with no check.

items.name: Climber's Kit
items.effect: Pitons, boot tips, gloves and a harness. Anchored in, you can't fall more than 25 ft.

items.name: Harvesting Kit
items.effect: Skinning knives, a bone saw, cleavers, hooks, stoppered vials, sealing jars and a pouch of preserving salts in a rolled leather case. Proficiency adds to harvest checks; without one, harvesting counts as using improvised tools (disadvantage).

items.name: Alchemist's Fire
items.effect: A flask of sticky liquid that bursts into flame on contact with air. Thrown (20 ft); on a hit the target burns for 1d4 fire damage each turn until it or someone spends an action to put it out (DC 10 Dex).

recipe.lore: Sulfur, saltpeter and pitch dissolved in oil — sealed airtight, since a cracked stopper means a burning workbench.

items.name: Acid (vial)
items.effect: A glass vial of acid, thrown (20 ft) or splashed on a creature within 5 ft: 2d6 acid damage on a hit.

items.name: Antitoxin
items.effect: Drink it to gain advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour. Does nothing for undead or constructs.

components.label: Any venom (a tiny dose, for the body to learn from)

recipe.lore: A trace of true venom, cut with herbs and honey, teaches the body to fight the rest.

items.name: Holy Water
items.effect: Thrown (20 ft) or splashed on a creature: a fiend or undead takes 2d6 radiant damage on a hit.

recipe.lore: Powdered silver is stirred into pure water and prayed over until the silver vanishes, leaving the water faintly luminous.
recipe.requires: Must be blessed by a cleric or paladin at a shrine; the traditional rite takes an hour and expends a 1st-level spell slot.

items.name: Basic Poison (vial)
items.effect: Coat a weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition (1 action). For 1 minute, a creature hit must make a DC 10 Con save or take 1d4 poison damage; the coating dries after that.

items.name: Perfume (vial)
items.effect: A small vial of scent that lingers for hours; helpful in polite society.

items.name: Soap
items.effect: A cake of hard lye soap.

items.name: Chalk (1 piece)
items.effect: A stick of white chalk for marking walls and floors.

items.name: Scent Lure
items.effect: A stoppered pot of musk and rendered fat; smeared on a trap or post, it draws beasts from a mile downwind.
